summary: Positions 152-299 (148 entries; Haiku: 48 photo, 10 unsure, 90 skip). Keep accepted: 25 of 48 (23 rejected). Fixes on 12 of the kept (17 field fixes). Ordinary types among the kept: 5 (Viborg town hall, Zenith de Rouen, Herman Teirlinck Building, Deloitte Building Christchurch, Osakidetza HQ Bilbao). Rescued: 2 (House Okamura, Fondazione Bertarelli Concert Hall). Total proposed to add: 27, of which 5 ordinary (18.5%, under 20%). Main photo changes: 3 (CUBE, Zenith de Rouen, IBM Studios). All 10 unsure stay out (no usable main photo or no photo; Yokoo and Col-legi Els Convents have unconfirmed architects). All 90 skips confirmed except the two rescued. Skips with strong photos but an empty or non-describing lead, left out under the empty-lead rule: Blessed Augustin Kazotic Church (Boris Magas, 152), Plassen Cultural Centre (3XN, 162), Church of Our Lady in Knin (289), Vennesla Church (221), Tikkurila Church (219). Year gaps filled from prep: 169, 189, 192, 193, 215, 255; IBM Studios stays null because prep's 2015 conflicts with the UniCredit Pavilion name and no source gives the year. Fame/quality notes: Hoshokan (157), Borgo Citta Nuova (169), Trinity River Audubon Center (215) and IBM Studios (194) are the thinnest keeps (lead says little; kept for an internationally known architect or a named idea); drop them first if the owner wants a stricter list. No duplicates on the wall (qid, name and 200 m check): Amare is 92 m from the Hague City Hall (different building) and Fourth and Madison 66 m from Seattle Central Library (different building).
